name: DataTableCell
description:
The shared rendering vocabulary for a DataTable cell. Encodes the
house rules once (status is a StatusDot plus a text label, never
color alone; identifiers are monospace; a usage bar/sparkline/
slider all state their number in text) so a hand-written column
def gets them without re-deriving them per screen.

Every kind renders into the same box — --dt-row-h tall, content
centred — so row height stops tracking whichever kind is tallest.
These CSS custom properties are defined by DataTable (--dt-row-h,
--dt-row-h-2, --dt-cell-h); this component only reads them.

It takes RESOLVED values, not the row — pulling a value out of a
row is the column's job, this only decides how it looks.
whenToUse: Every cell of a DataTable: pick the kind by content — text, mono, primary, status, badge, usage, sparkline.
Editable cells (input, number, select, combobox, switch…) for inline edits in a table.

whenNotToUse.instead: the matching component: Badge, StatusDot, TextField…

whenNotToUse.text: Editing many fields of one row
whenNotToUse.instead: a Drawer or a detail page

anatomy.description: one row height for the whole table (`lines` 1 or 2); `loading` draws the kind’s own placeholder.

do.caption: The main value on top, details on the second line.

dont.caption: Four facts in one line truncate, and none of them can be sorted.

do.caption: Status: a dot plus a word.

dont.caption: An internal code people have to look up.

a11y: Editable kinds need a `label` — usually “column, row” (“Plan, shop.seashell.dev”); it isn’t visible in the cell.
Invalid edits show a real message linked to the field, not only a red border.
Status and badge kinds always carry a word; color is never the only signal.

props.name: total
props.description: null for an unlimited/indeterminate quota: no bar, no misleading 0%.

props.name: value
props.description: ONE value: a cell has no room for a two-thumb range — that belongs in `custom`.

props.name: badges
props.description: Several badges, worst severity first. Collapse from the tail as the column narrows.

props.name: below
props.description: Extra lines under `secondary` — sized as a minimum since they appear only at some widths.

props.name: collapsedLabel
props.description: Noun used once every badge collapses into one ("4 alerts"). Defaults to "badges".

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Doubles as the visible readout and the thumb's aria-valuetext. Defaults to the bare number.

props.name: grow
props.description: Keep the row height as a minimum rather than fixed, for content whose line count varies by row.

props.name: label
props.description:
Required: status is never color alone.
The number the trend belongs to — carries the meaning; the line only shows the shape.
Required: name the ROW, not the action — "Select shop.seashell.dev".

props.name: leading
props.description: Sits before the text: an Avatar, an icon, a favicon. Keep it ≤32px.

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines the cell is sized for. You rarely pass it — inherits the table's `lines` unless this cell has a second line of its own.

props.name: loading
props.description: Render the first-load placeholder for this kind instead of the value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string) => void) | ((value: string) => void) | ((value: number | null) => void) | ((value: string) => void) | ((value: string) => void) | ((value: string) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void) | ((value: DateRange) => void) | ((value: number) => void)

props.name: options
props.type: string[] | AutocompleteOption[] | ComboboxOption[] | { value: string; label: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; }[]

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Value stays selectable and normal-ink; gives up border/hover wash/affordances.

props.name: revealOnHover
props.description: Keep the control invisible until hovered/focused/open. Needs `group/row` on the row.

props.name: secondaryMono
props.description: Render the second line in monospace (right for an identifier, wrong for a sentence).

props.name: size
props.description: Applies to every badge in the group, including the collapsed "N more" pill.

components.name: DataTableCellMenuTrigger
components.description: The trigger for a `menu` cell: the row's overflow control. Ghost, full 44px touch target below md.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead of a <button> (shadcn/Radix Slot convention).

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders as a square icon-only button (no label). Provide the icon via leftIcon.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (or the sole icon when iconOnly is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of leftIcon and disables the button. Not supported with asChild.

props.name: rightIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.
